Thc Proiect

The subject property is improved with a two and half story residential building on the front of the property
containing four residential dwelling units and a rear one-story residential building containing one residential
dwelling units for a total of five residential dwelling units. There is no on-site parking on the properry. 2412
Belden LLC (the "Applicant") proposes rezone the properfy from a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) District to an RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District to allow construction of dormer additions to the
existing Êont residential building to expand the size of the existing residential dwelling units. The rezoning rvill
allow for sufficient FAR to accommodatc thc added Floor Area from the construction of the dormer additions.
The number of residential units on the property, howcver, will not increase and will remain at a total of five
residential dwelling units. No parking will be added. The height of the front building will be 36 feel 6 and 19/32
incheS. The height of the rear building is and will rcmain at 28.00 feet.

The subject properly is located in a block that is improved wilh residential buildings west of the alley next west
of No¡th Westem Avenue. East of that alley, the block has commercial buildings. The area immediately east of
the subject building is zoned B3-2 and the area west of the alley next west of North Western Avenue is generally
zoned RS-3 with some properties zoned RT-3.5 and RT-4.0. Thcre are a number of residential buildings in the
area that exceed the RS-3 lnaximum permitted FAR and have multiple dwelling units. There also are a number
of buildings in the immediate area with dormer additions.

                                        ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO;

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 5-1 in the area bounded by:

              The public alley next north of and parallel to West Belden Avenue;
              the public alley next west of and parallel to North Western Avenue;
              West Belden Avenue; and a line 142.40 feet west of and parallel to
              North Western Avenue

to those of an RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Address: 2412 West Belden Avenue

           residential building and continue the rear 1 dwelling unit with no changes for a total of 5
           dwelling units on the Zoning Lot.

13.    Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling
       units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space; and
       height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)
      The subject property is improved with a two and half-story residential building containing four residential dwelling units in
      the front of the property and a two-story residential building at the rear of property with one residential dwelling unit and
      no parkino. The Applicant seeks to add dormers to the front building to expand the size of the existing units in the front building.
      No expansion of the rear building is proposed. After the addition of the dormers to the front building, the property will contain a
      total of five residential dwelling units with four residential dwelling units in the front building and one residential dwelling unit in
      the rear building. No parking will be added. The height of the front building after the addition of the dormers will be 36 ft. 7 in.
      The height of the rear building will remain at 25 ft. 7 in.
14.   The Affordable Requrements Ordinance (ARC) requires on-site affordable housing units and/or
      a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that receive a zoning
      change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area, or, for existing Planned
